# Draftava 1.3.13
- Moves routine workspace-change checks to the background persistence worker to reduce main-thread work following autosaves. - Adds safeguards against applying outdated reconciliation results after new edits, saves, or project switching. - Preserves the 300 ms autosave debounce and existing conflict protection.
Some uncommon conflict-resolution paths may still perform main-thread work. Further performance investigation remains open.
